summary: The filing is a routine Form 6-K by Descartes Systems Group Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnishing its quarterly report to shareholders for the quarter ended April 30, 2026, and a press release dated June 3, 2026. It contains standard financial results, management discussion and analysis, and condensed consolidated financial statements. There are no event-driven special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing is a periodic earnings release, not a special situation.
